**Repository**
https://github.com/ReneHollander/typeorm-composite-key-one-to-many-issue
**More Info:**
When removing [Line 18 in RecurringOrder.ts](https://github.com/ReneHollander/typeorm-composite-key-one-to-many-issue/blob/master/src/entity/RecurringOrder.ts#L18) (The OneToMany relation) the results are as expected: RecurringOrderItem table gets the keys and foreign key constraints to RecurringOrder. But when adding it, RecurringOrderItem don't get keys and foreign key constraints to RecurringOrder.
This not only breaks schema creation, but also produces invalid joins when querying with the offending relations enabled.

With OneToMany (not working):
```sql
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `city` (`postcode` int(11) NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `enabled` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(`postcode`, `name`)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `delivery_slot` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `by` time NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `user` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `cityPostcode` int(11), `cityName` varchar(255)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `product` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `price` decimal(2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `recurring_order_item` (`amount` int(11) NOT NULL, `productId` int(11), PRIMARY KEY(`productId`)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `recurring_order` (`enabled` tinyint(4) NOT NULL, `deliverySlotId` int(11), `userId` int(11), PRIMARY KEY(`deliverySlotId`, `userId`)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  ALTER TABLE `user` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_a13d1092374c1f2608cc7643792` FOREIGN KEY (`cityPostcode`, `cityName`) REFERENCES `city`(`postcode`,`name`)
executing query:  ALTER TABLE `recurring_order_item` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_d2392852d4ba6a1f97b4e88859f` FOREIGN KEY (`productId`) REFERENCES `product`(`id`)
executing query:  ALTER TABLE `recurring_order` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_3a1d42a0dabb92933ec744e3ebc` FOREIGN KEY (`deliverySlotId`) REFERENCES `delivery_slot`(`id`)
executing query:  ALTER TABLE `recurring_order` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_44f5a204fa6f798ce047f5afef1` FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`)
```
Without OneToMany (working):
```sql
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `city` (`postcode` int(11) NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `enabled` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(`postcode`, `name`)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `delivery_slot` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `by` time NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `user` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `cityPostcode` int(11), `cityName` varchar(255)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `recurring_order` (`enabled` tinyint(4) NOT NULL, `deliverySlotId` int(11), `userId` int(11), PRIMARY KEY(`deliverySlotId`, `userId`)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `product` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `price` decimal(2) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  CREATE TABLE `recurring_order_item` (`amount` int(11) NOT NULL, `recurringOrderDeliverySlot` int(11), `recurringOrderUser` int(11), `productId` int(11), PRIMARY KEY(`recurringOrderDeliverySlot`, `recurringOrderUser`, `productId`)) ENGINE=InnoDB
executing query:  ALTER TABLE `user` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_a13d1092374c1f2608cc7643792` FOREIGN KEY (`cityPostcode`, `cityName`) REFERENCES `city`(`postcode`,`name`)
executing query:  ALTER TABLE `recurring_order` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_3a1d42a0dabb92933ec744e3ebc` FOREIGN KEY (`deliverySlotId`) REFERENCES `delivery_slot`(`id`)
executing query:  ALTER TABLE `recurring_order` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_44f5a204fa6f798ce047f5afef1` FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`)
executing query:  ALTER TABLE `recurring_order_item` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_aff03025d49d5cccbc24aa23fb4` FOREIGN KEY (`recurringOrderDeliverySlot`, `recurringOrderUser`) REFERENCES `recurring_order`(`deliverySlotId`,`userId`)
executing query:  ALTER TABLE `recurring_order_item` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_d2392852d4ba6a1f97b4e88859f` FOREIGN KEY (`productId`) REFERENCES `product`(`id`)
```

Broken query `recurringOrderRepository.find({relations: ["items"]}` (ON clause at end is missing):
```sql
query failed:  SELECT `RecurringOrder`.`enabled` AS `RecurringOrder_enabled`, `RecurringOrder`.`deliverySlotId` AS `RecurringOrder_deliverySlotId`, `RecurringOrder`.`userId` AS `RecurringOrder_userId`, `RecurringOrder_items`.`amount` AS `RecurringOrder_items_amount`, `RecurringOrder_items`.`productId` AS `RecurringOrder_items_productId` FROM `recurring_order` `RecurringOrder` LEFT JOIN `recurring_order_item` `RecurringOrder_items` ON
```

Maybe related to #43 and #58.
